title: Sweetest Illusion by Basia 1994 Sony Music Entertainment Epic Records Group
descriptionText: "Sweetest Illusion" by Basia is a 1994 album released by Sony Music Entertainment under the Epic Records Group. Produced by Danny White, the album features a mix of pop and rock genres within the musical style. With a run time of 53 minutes, this CD offers a collection of catchy tunes and heartfelt lyrics that capture the essence of Basia's music during that era. Perfect for fans of pop and rock music from the 90s, "Sweetest Illusion" is a timeless album that continues to charm listeners today.
